edges.reason: initialize requires msg.sender == DEPLOYER, so caller identity directly gates the initializer.
The immutable DEPLOYER address is the sole authority permitted to call initialize.
initialize delegatecalls GOVERNANCE.listCurrency so arbitrary governance code executes in proxy storage context.
hasInitialized is written so that the initializer cannot be invoked a second time.
owner is assigned during initialize and controls all governance routing.
fallback resolves the target implementation from msg.sig via getRouterImplementation.
fallback forwards execution into _delegate with the resolved implementation.
Raw assembly delegatecall hands complete control of context to the implementation contract.
nTokenTransferApprove requires msg.sender == nTokenAddress to authorize the allowance write.
nTokenTransfer only permits the nToken proxy as caller.
nTokenTransferFrom only permits the nToken proxy as caller before consuming allowance.
nTokenTransferApproveAll keys the blanket whitelist entry on msg.sender.
nTokenClaimIncentives credits incentives to the account derived from msg.sender.
nTokenRedeem requires msg.sender == redeemer or address(this) before redeeming.
nTokenRedeemViaBatch requires msg.sender == address(this) to prevent external invocation.
Approval writes nTokenAllowance[tokenHolder][spender][currencyId].
transferFrom reads and decrements the per-currency allowance before transferring.
When no specific allowance exists the blanket whitelist allowance is consumed instead.
Allowance view reads the specific nTokenAllowance first.
Allowance view falls back to the blanket nTokenWhitelist when specific allowance is zero.
nTokenTransferApproveAll writes nTokenWhitelist[msg.sender][spender].
nTokenTransfer delegates the balance mutation to the internal _transfer routine.
nTokenTransferFrom delegates the balance mutation to the internal _transfer routine.
Balance finalization performs external token transfers which can call back into the system.
nTokenRedeem is wrapped by the nonReentrant modifier to block reentrant redemption.
The modifier writes reentrancyStatus to _ENTERED and restores _NOT_ENTERED.
nTokenRedeem invokes _redeem to compute asset cash and residual fCash.
Claim loop calls claimIncentives per active currency balance.
Incentive accrual depends on block.timestamp making reward amounts miner-influenced.
blockTimestamp drives settlement and nextSettleTime comparisons in redemption.
blockTime flows into _redeem and downstream fCash market pricing.
nTokenMint reads block.timestamp to price minted tokens and validate settle times.
owner_ parameter is stored directly into the owner state variable.
amount parameter drives the nToken balance mutation in _transfer.
from parameter selects the sender balance to decrement.
to parameter selects the recipient balance to increment.
redeemer parameter is used for authorization and balance loading.
tokensToRedeem_ is cast to int256 and subtracted from stored balances requiring bounds checks.
sellTokenAssets parameter branches between selling fCash and placing residuals.
amountToDepositInternal is multiplied and divided by supply/PV ratios in the mint calculation.

normalization_plan.reason: owner_ is a call parameter only meaningful inside the initialize function.
pauseRouter_ is only consumed by initialize when assigning pauseRouter.
pauseGuardian_ is only consumed by initialize when assigning pauseGuardian.
sig is the selector input that solely determines the routing branch.
currencyId is the lookup key used by the balance handler for the queried nToken.
account is the subject address of the balance query.
tokenHolder keys the allowance mapping written by this approve call.
spender indexes the blanket whitelist entry created for msg.sender.
amount is the transfer value consumed by the delegated _transfer call.
from identifies the source balance mutated during the transfer.
to identifies the destination balance mutated during the transfer.
redeemer is the authorization subject and account being redeemed.
tokensToRedeem_ is the redemption quantity validated against stored balances.
sellTokenAssets toggles the residual fCash handling branch during redemption.
nTokenAddress is the storage key for the queried supply factors.
amountToDepositInternal is the deposit quantity converted into minted tokens.
allowance caches the permission value read and decremented during the transferFrom flow.
implementation is the resolved target consumed by the delegatecall forwarding logic.
balance state object tracks nToken and cash mutations inside the redeem flow.
blockTime is the cached timestamp threaded through the redemption calculations.
accumulator local only exists to sum incentives within the claim routine.
amountInt is the signed conversion of the transfer amount used in balance finalization.
senderContext carries the sender account context mutated by the transfer routine.
recipientContext carries the recipient account context mutated by the transfer routine.
tokensToRedeem is the signed redemption amount scoped to the redeem action.
context is the account context memory used and re-stored during redemption.
